description.ar: صمم news feed سوشيال زي Twitter/Instagram
description.en: Design a social news feed like Twitter/Instagram

problemStatement.ar: صمم نظام news feed ليوزرز يتابعوا بعض. لازم تدعم نشر بوست، قراءة home feed بسرعة، وتعامل مع مشاهير عندهم ملايين المتابعين. رتّب النقاش حوالين fan-out وranking.
problemStatement.en: Design a news feed for users who follow each other. Support publishing, fast home feed reads, and celebrities with millions of followers. Focus discussion on fan-out and ranking.

prompt.ar: قبل التصميم: اسأل عن scope الـ الـ news feed واعمل حسبة سريعة.
prompt.en: Before designing: clarify the news feed scope and do a quick estimate.

text.ar: سألت عن DAU، متوسط المتابَعين، وposts/user/day
text.en: Asked about DAU, avg followees, and posts/user/day

ar.how: اسأل كمان عن celebrity threshold وranking requirements.
ar.tradeoffs: Feed مرتب زمني أبسط من ranked.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تصمم fanout من غير distribution الـ graph.

en.how: Also ask celebrity threshold and ranking needs.
en.mistakes: Mistake: designing fanout without graph distribution.

text.ar: قدّرت write fanout: posts/sec × avg followers
text.en: Estimated write fanout: posts/sec × avg followers

ar.why: ده حجم الشغل على الـ timeline store.
ar.how: 100M DAU × 0.2 post × avg 200 followers… قسّم على اليوم.
ar.examples: Hybrid: push للعادي، pull للـ celebs.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تستخدم المتوسط من غير percentile للـ celebs.

en.why: That is the work volume on the timeline store.
en.how: 100M DAU × 0.2 post × avg 200 followers… divide by day.
en.mistakes: Mistake: using the mean without celeb percentiles.

text.ar: وضّحت freshness SLO: ثواني قليلة للـ home feed
text.en: Clarified freshness SLO: a few seconds for home feed

ar.why: الـ product expectation بتقود الـ architecture.
ar.how: اسأل: هل OK تأخير 30 ث للـ ranked؟
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعد real-time من غير budget.

en.how: Ask: is 30s delay OK for ranked?
en.mistakes: Mistake: promising real-time without a budget.

text.ar: سألت عن media vs text-only وads injection
text.en: Asked about media vs text-only and ads injection

ar.how: Pointers للـ media مش binary في الـ timeline.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تخزن صورة كاملة في Cassandra row.

en.how: Pointers to media, not binaries in the timeline.
en.mistakes: Mistake: storing full images in a Cassandra row.

prompt.ar: اوصف fan-out on write vs read، الـ timeline store، والـ ranking pipeline.
prompt.en: Describe fan-out on write vs read, the timeline store, and ranking pipeline.

text.ar: 📊 Client → LB → API → Queue/Worker fanout → Timeline DB + Cache
text.en: 📊 Client → LB → API → Queue/Worker fanout → Timeline DB + Cache

ar.why: فصل الـ publish عن الـ serve.
ar.how: Publish يكتب post DB ويـ enqueue fanout. Read يقرأ timeline + hydrate.
ar.tradeoffs: Sync fanout أبسط وأبطأ للـ user.
ar.examples: Twitter early timeline، IG feed services.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: fanout sync جوّا request الـ post.

en.how: Publish writes post DB and enqueues fanout. Read reads timeline + hydrate.
en.tradeoffs: Sync fanout is simpler and slower for the user.
en.examples: Twitter early timeline, IG feed services.
en.mistakes: Mistake: sync fanout inside the post request.

text.ar: Fan-out on write للـ regular users؛ pull للـ celebrities
text.en: Fan-out on write for regular users; pull for celebrities

ar.how: Threshold مثلاً 10k followers → لا تدفع، اقرأ عند الطلب.
ar.tradeoffs: Threshold غلط = إما تكلفة أو latency.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: push لكل celebrities.

en.how: Threshold e.g. 10k followers → don't push; pull on read.
en.tradeoffs: Wrong threshold = either cost or latency.
en.mistakes: Mistake: pushing for all celebrities.

text.ar: Timeline store: Cassandra/Dynamo key=user_id, clustered by time/score
text.en: Timeline store: Cassandra/Dynamo key=user_id, clustered by time/score

ar.why: Access pattern: أحدث N لـ user.
ar.how: Wide-row أو bucketed partitions. TTL اختياري.
ar.tradeoffs: SQL ممكن للصغر؛ NoSQL للـ huge fanout.
ar.examples: Cassandra feeds، Redis cache للـ hot users.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: جدول SQL فيه row لكل (user,post) من غير sharding.

en.why: Access pattern: latest N for a user.
en.how: Wide-row or bucketed partitions. Optional TTL.
en.tradeoffs: SQL OK when small; NoSQL for huge fanout.
en.examples: Cassandra feeds, Redis cache for hot users.
en.mistakes: Mistake: SQL row per (user,post) without sharding.

text.ar: Hydration service: post content + social proof من caches
text.en: Hydration service: post content + social proof from caches

ar.why: الـ timeline فيه IDs؛ المحتوى يتجاب منفصل.
ar.how: Batch get posts. Cache-aside. Filter blocks/mutes.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تخزن النص الكامل في كل timeline copy.

en.why: Timeline has IDs; content is fetched separately.
en.how: Batch get posts. Cache-aside. Filter blocks/mutes.
en.mistakes: Mistake: storing full text in every timeline copy.

prompt.ar: إزاي تـ scale للـ celebrities والـ dense graphs؟
prompt.en: How do you scale for celebrities and dense graphs?

text.ar: Shard timelines by user_id؛ workers يتقسموا على partitions
text.en: Shard timelines by user_id; workers partitioned

ar.how: Kafka partitions by actor أو by follower shards.
ar.tradeoffs: Rebalance صعب وقت نمو الـ graph.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: queue واحدة من غير partitioning.

en.how: Kafka partitions by actor or follower shards.
en.tradeoffs: Rebalance is hard as the graph grows.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one queue without partitioning.

text.ar: Celebrity spillover: pull + cache ranked recent posts
text.en: Celebrity spillover: pull + cache ranked recent posts

ar.why: مش هتقدر تكتب لملايين الـ timelines.
ar.how: عند read: merge user timeline + celeb recent.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: نفس path للـ celeb والعادي.

en.why: You cannot write to millions of timelines.
en.how: On read: merge user timeline + celeb recent.
en.mistakes: Mistake: same path for celeb and normal.

text.ar: Cache home feed للـ active users مع short TTL + invalidation
text.en: Cache home feed for active users with short TTL + invalidation

ar.how: Redis list/ZSET. Invalidate على post جديد مهم.
ar.tradeoffs: TTL قصير = load أعلى. طويل = stale.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: cache من غير invalidation للـ deletes.

en.how: Redis list/ZSET. Invalidate on important new posts.
en.tradeoffs: Short TTL = more load. Long = stale.
en.mistakes: Mistake: cache without invalidation for deletes.

prompt.ar: إيه SLIs: feed freshness، p99 latency، fanout lag؟
prompt.en: What SLIs: feed freshness, p99 latency, fanout lag?

text.ar: SLOs: feed p99 < 200ms، freshness < 5s للـ 99%
text.en: SLOs: feed p99 < 200ms, freshness < 5s for 99%

ar.why: لازم تقيس تجربة اليوزر مش بس QPS.
ar.how: Trace publish→fanout→visible.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تراقب API latency بس وتنسى fanout lag.

en.why: Measure user experience, not just QPS.
en.how: Trace publish→fanout→visible.
en.mistakes: Mistake: watching API latency only and ignoring fanout lag.

text.ar: Alert على fanout lag وDLQ depth
text.en: Alert on fanout lag and DLQ depth

ar.how: Lag > 30s page. DLQ > N investigate.
ar.tradeoffs: Noise vs signal في الـ alerts.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: مفيش DLQ → رسائل ضايعة صامتة.

en.how: Lag > 30s page. DLQ > N investigate.
en.mistakes: Mistake: no DLQ → silent message loss.

text.ar: Track empty-feed وhydration miss rates
text.en: Track empty-feed and hydration miss rates

ar.how: Monitor % empty و% broken leaves.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعتبر empty feed طبيعي دايمًا.

en.how: Monitor % empty and % broken leaves.
en.mistakes: Mistake: treating empty feed as always normal.

prompt.ar: اختناقات: hot celebrities، ranking CPU، cache stampedes؟
prompt.en: Bottlenecks: hot celebrities, ranking CPU, cache stampedes?

text.ar: Hot celebrity publish storms
text.en: Hot celebrity publish storms

ar.how: Detect celebs، skip push، pull path.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: autoscale بس من غير celeb policy.

en.how: Detect celebs, skip push, pull path.
en.mistakes: Mistake: only autoscaling without celeb policy.

text.ar: Ranking CPU على read path
text.en: Ranking CPU on the read path

ar.how: Precompute scores async. Light re-rank online.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: deep model على كل scroll.

en.why: ML features are expensive if sync.
en.how: Precompute scores async. Light re-rank online.
en.mistakes: Mistake: deep model on every scroll.

text.ar: Cache stampede بعد deploy أو mass invalidation
text.en: Cache stampede after deploy or mass invalidation

ar.why: كل الناس تضرب DB مع بعض.
ar.how: Request coalescing، soft TTL، jitter.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: flush كل الـ cache مرة واحدة.

en.how: Request coalescing, soft TTL, jitter.
en.mistakes: Mistake: flushing the entire cache at once.

prompt.ar: Fan-out on write vs read، وpush vs pull hybrid.
prompt.en: Fan-out on write vs read, and push vs pull hybrid.

text.ar: Fan-out on write vs fan-out on read
text.en: Fan-out on write vs fan-out on read

ar.how: ارسم الـ graph density واختار hybrid.
ar.tradeoffs: Write أحسن للـ read-heavy. Read أحسن للـ write-heavy celebs.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تختار واحد بس لكل اليوزرز.

en.how: Plot graph density and choose hybrid.
en.tradeoffs: Write better for read-heavy. Read better for write-heavy celebs.
en.mistakes: Mistake: picking only one for all users.

text.ar: Chronological vs ranked feed
text.en: Chronological vs ranked feed

ar.how: ابدأ chronological، زوّد ranking تدريجي.
ar.tradeoffs: Ranked أعقد في الخصوصية والـ debugging.
ar.examples: IG ranked؛ some apps still chrono.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: ranking من غير explainability/debug tools.

en.how: Start chronological, add ranking gradually.
en.tradeoffs: Ranked is harder for privacy and debugging.
en.examples: IG ranked; some apps still chrono.
en.mistakes: Mistake: ranking without explainability/debug tools.

text.ar: Strong vs eventual visibility بعد الـ post
text.en: Strong vs eventual visibility after posting

ar.why: الكاتب عايز يشوف فورًا؛ المتابعين eventual OK.
ar.how: Read-your-writes من cache محلي للكاتب.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعد linearizability على كل الـ feeds.

en.why: Author wants immediate; followers eventual OK.
en.how: Read-your-writes via author local cache.
en.tradeoffs: Strong for all followers is expensive.
en.mistakes: Mistake: promising linearizability on all feeds.

prompt.ar: إزاي تعمل soft-delete وprivacy على posts اتوزعت؟
prompt.en: How do you handle soft-delete and privacy on already-fanned posts?

text.ar: حذف/تعديل post بعد الـ fanout
text.en: Delete/edit a post after fanout

ar.how: Tombstones + lazy cleanup + hydration filter.
ar.examples: Soft delete flags on post store.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تمسح من post DB بس والـ timelines تفضل.

en.how: Tombstones + lazy cleanup + hydration filter.
en.examples: Soft delete flags on post store.
en.mistakes: Mistake: deleting only post DB while timelines remain.

text.ar: Mute/block realtime enforcement
text.en: Mute/block realtime enforcement

ar.how: Filter عند hydration + invalidate caches.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعتمد على fanout rewrite بس.

en.how: Filter at hydration + invalidate caches.
en.mistakes: Mistake: relying only on fanout rewrite.

text.ar: Pagination: cursor based مش offset
text.en: Pagination: cursor-based not offset

ar.how: Cursor = (score, post_id).
ar.tradeoffs: Cursor أصعب في الـ ranked mixes.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: OFFSET كبير على Cassandra.

en.how: Cursor = (score, post_id).
en.tradeoffs: Cursors are harder with ranked mixes.
en.mistakes: Mistake: large OFFSET on Cassandra.

prompt.ar: قدّر تكلفة timeline storage والـ fanout workers.
prompt.en: Estimate timeline storage and fanout worker cost.

text.ar: Timeline storage ≈ fanout writes/day × bytes × retention
text.en: Timeline storage ≈ fanout writes/day × bytes × retention

ar.how: احسب avg fanout × posts × 100B × days.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تنسى replication factor ×3.

en.why: Duplicated copies are the big cost.
en.how: Compute avg fanout × posts × 100B × days.
en.mistakes: Mistake: forgetting ×3 replication factor.

text.ar: Worker cost يتناسب مع celebrity policy
text.en: Worker cost scales with celebrity policy

ar.why: Push للـ celebs بيفجر الـ bill.
ar.how: Simulate cost عند thresholds مختلفة.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تحسب workers من average بس.

en.how: Simulate cost at different thresholds.
en.mistakes: Mistake: sizing workers from average only.

text.ar: Cache hit rate هدف >90% لـ active DAU
text.en: Cache hit rate target >90% for active DAU

ar.how: Size cache لـ online users × page.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: cache صغير ويتحول stampede.

en.how: Size cache for online users × page.
en.mistakes: Mistake: tiny cache that becomes a stampede.

prompt.ar: Privacy: block lists، GDPR delete، visibility rules.
prompt.en: Privacy: block lists, GDPR delete, visibility rules.

text.ar: Visibility rules: public/followers/private تتفرض عند hydration
text.en: Visibility rules: public/followers/private enforced at hydration

ar.why: النسخ في timelines مش كافية كـ authz.
ar.how: Central post authz check قبل الرجوع.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تثق إن وجود leaf = مسموح بالعرض.

en.why: Timeline copies are not enough for authz.
en.how: Central post authz check before return.
en.mistakes: Mistake: trusting leaf presence as view permission.

text.ar: GDPR delete: erase post + async scrub timelines
text.en: GDPR delete: erase post + async scrub timelines

ar.how: Authoritative delete + tombstone + batch scrub.
ar.tradeoffs: فوري 100% scrub صعب عند fanout ضخم.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: soft delete من غير scrub plan.

en.how: Authoritative delete + tombstone + batch scrub.
en.tradeoffs: Immediate 100% scrub is hard at huge fanout.
en.mistakes: Mistake: soft delete without a scrub plan.

text.ar: Abuse: spam fanout rate limits على publish
text.en: Abuse: spam fanout rate limits on publish

ar.how: Per-user publish limits + spam models.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: مفيش cap على publish rate.

en.how: Per-user publish limits + spam models.
en.mistakes: Mistake: no cap on publish rate.

prompt.ar: Multi-region feeds وRPO للـ timeline replicas.
prompt.en: Multi-region feeds and RPO for timeline replicas.

text.ar: Timeline replicas multi-AZ؛ post store مصدر الحقيقة
text.en: Timeline replicas multi-AZ; post store is source of truth

ar.how: RPO صغير للـ posts؛ timelines تعيد fanout.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعتبر timeline irreparable state من غير rebuild.

en.how: Small RPO for posts; timelines can re-fanout.
en.tradeoffs: Rebuild is slow after major loss.
en.mistakes: Mistake: treating timeline as irreparable without rebuild.

text.ar: Active-active read regions مع sticky writers
text.en: Active-active read regions with sticky writers

ar.how: Replicate posts؛ regional timelines أو shared.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: dual write من غير conflict policy.

en.how: Replicate posts; regional or shared timelines.
en.mistakes: Mistake: dual write without conflict policy.

text.ar: GameDay: اقتل fanout workers وقيس freshness SLO
text.en: GameDay: kill fanout workers and measure freshness SLO

ar.how: Serve cached/stale with banner metrics.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: مفيش stale fallback.

en.how: Serve cached/stale with banner metrics.
en.tradeoffs: Stale OK up to a point.
en.mistakes: Mistake: no stale fallback.

rangeHint.en: A leaf is usually tens to hundreds of bytes.

rangeHint.ar: Active online set أصغر من DAU.
rangeHint.en: Active online set is smaller than DAU.

steps.ar: 1) Posts/day = DAU × posts/user. Fanout writes = posts × avg followers.
steps.en: 1) Posts/day = DAU × posts/user. Fanout writes = posts × avg followers.

description.ar: الـ workers مش لاحقين. البوستات بتظهر متأخر. إيه الأولوية؟
description.en: Workers cannot keep up. Posts appear late. What is the priority?

checklist.ar: Serve stale cache بوضوح في المقاييس
checklist.en: Serve stale cache with clear metrics
Scale workers and pause non-critical ranking

description.ar: حساب عليه 50M متابع نشر. الـ queue بتولّع.
description.en: An account with 50M followers posted. The queue is on fire.

checklist.en: Switch the account to pull path

checklist.ar: Rate limit fanout jobs لنفس الـ actor
checklist.en: Rate limit fanout jobs for the same actor

checklist.ar: Communicate status لو الـ freshness اتأثرت
checklist.en: Communicate status if freshness is impacted

expectedNote.ar: Hybrid هو الجواب العملي: push للعادي وpull للـ celebs.
expectedNote.en: Hybrid is the practical answer: push for normal, pull for celebs.

whenOtherWins.ar: Pull لما توزيع المتابعين heavy-tailed جدًا.
whenOtherWins.en: Pull when follower distribution is very heavy-tailed.

expectedNote.ar: ابدأ زمني لو الفريق صغير؛ ranked لما الـ engagement هدف.
expectedNote.en: Start chronological if the team is small; ranked when engagement is the goal.

whenOtherWins.ar: Ranked لو الـ ads/discovery جزء من الـ product.
whenOtherWins.en: Ranked if ads/discovery are part of the product.

caption.ar: Job يتتحط على queue للـ fanout
Worker يكتب على timelines في الـ cache/store
caption.en: Worker writes follower timelines in cache/store
Merge celeb pull + filters and return
